notes.title: Basilisk Update 0.13 - 0.22
notes.content: [p]Hello.[/p][p]We've made some good progress recently.[/p][p]Basilisk has some hot config UI action, setting up the rockets, enemies now have shields, the enemy formation system is sorted, experimented with a hypnotic background and loads of little tweaks and bug fixes along the way.[/p][p]We've been posting across various socials so check those for daily updates: [url="https://linktr.ee/projector_studios"]linktree[/url] [/p][p]Here's another compilation video here of all those recent updates... [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-slSyK-blm8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Basilisk Update 0.6 - 0.12
notes.content:
Hello.
We've switched from Unity to Godot so we restarted development on Basilisk.
Luckily, Godot is so nice to use that we're not far from getting back to where we were already.
We've been posting across various socials - check linktree for links: [url=https://linktr.ee/projector_studios]linktree[/url]
Now I understand how to post YouTube shorts, we've posted a compilation video here of all the recent updates...

[previewyoutube=EYstWYQGKm8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 0.8 - 1000x
notes.content:
I switched a load of stuff on and forget to set reload times which ended up with this thing of beauty. Made me think that the enemies should be powerful and require loads of hits. This will mean that the player will fill the screen with bullets to kill anything. Glorious.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44623087/eb9c31d4af3b790338e9319086aeb244ee019696.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.7 - More Weapons!
notes.content:
Added more weapons to the config screen. You can only choose 6 to use in-game so I've added limitations on selection and a Randomise! button.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44623087/69331483dd52b195576e3886f4578990de586b04.gif[/img]

Wishlist Basilisk now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553700/Basilisk/

notes.title: Update 0.6 - Shields
notes.content:
There's a chance that the Basilisk ability could be overpowered. So I've added shields that can counter that ability if needed.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44623087/f5dd913e123fe8b873bb4fee596cb92434313a6e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.5 - Disabling
notes.content:
Now I have the functionality of the Basilisk ability sorted - the game will slow and an enemy can be disabled after a few seconds of targetting and hit for triple damage.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44623087/cc4c272b5bc3175c2d8fe823786ec19c06760b9d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Petrification
notes.content:
I needed a strobing visual effect for the Basilisk ability. The quick first attempt turned out nicely. I love it when that happens.
The idea is that the player can use this ability to disable enemies. Attacks on petrified enemies will cause much more damage.
Strategy!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44623087/4db1e03452ab5c51187180869d2688a84df09ca3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.3 - Sloooow-moooooo
notes.content:
SLOOOOOW-MOOOOOO!!!  Oh yeah, and I've got the basics of the player-enemy dynamic up and running. But, more importantly, SLOW-MO!!!
